Product introduction

The ZGS combined transformer integrates the transformer body, high-voltage load switch and fuses in insulating oil. Low-voltage metering and compensation can be configured for ring-network or terminal distribution and renewable-energy systems.

Configuration options

High-voltage arrangement
Air-insulated or C-GIS switchgear, load switches, switch-fuse combinations and circuit breakers provide alternative network interfaces.
Transformer and LV arrangement
Dry-type or oil-immersed transformers can be combined with fixed or drawer-type LV switchgear, metering and compensation.
Enclosure and auxiliaries
Coordinate enclosure protection, auxiliary power, metering, protection and communication interfaces with the site.

Project applications

Distribution and renewable-energy sites

Integrated transformer and switchgear arrangements serve ring-network and terminal distribution, industrial facilities and renewable-energy connections.

Substation project exchange in Brazil

Equipment presentation and technical exchange connect prefabricated substation arrangements with project requirements in Brazil.
